responsibility: Provides the main PA-RISC HP-UX 11.x target configuration. It expands the HP-UX builtins logic for different UNIX standard levels and C/C++ modes, defines pthread and large-file CPP behavior, customizes HP-UX 11 linker, library, startup-file, and tool-path specs, updates ABI type definitions, enables init/fini support and SOM weak-linker capabilities available on 11.x, and marks the target as `TARGET_HPUX_11`, making it the central OS-version layer for PA on HP-UX 11.
